authority_precedence: final applicable official pre-open daily row, if available
official dated rule + issuer/exchange event + official reference + tick/rounding
vendor fields only after independent reconstruction comparison
sse: Use date-versioned rule, effective event, official previous close (adjusted ex-dividend), 0.01 tick, ROUND_HALF_UP and one-tick minimum; cpxx N absolute prices are authoritative when a historical row is present. Never infer actual 2024 IPO limit from obsolete P display bounds.
szse: Use HasPriceLimit and LimitType when an actual cashauctionparams row is available. LimitType=1 ignores Absolute fields; LimitType=2 validates stated absolute upper/lower prices; HasPriceLimit=N nulls limits. These cases use official-rule reconstruction, not fabricated cashauctionparams rows.
ten_percent_regime: derived from validated historical rule and canonical constraint; never from ST label, stock name, or observed return
coverage: 13 representative security-days, not exhaustive market-wide certification
